Stratos Wealth Partners Ltd decreased its stake in Chevron Corp New (CVX) by 6.49% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Stratos Wealth Partners Ltd sold 3,106 shares as the company’s stock rose 6.62% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 44,761 shares of the integrated oil company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $5.11M, down from 47,867 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Stratos Wealth Partners Ltd who had been investing in Chevron Corp New for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $243.00B market cap company. The stock increased 1.19% or $1.5 during the last trading session, reaching $127.16. About 1.13 million shares traded.
